Maya R: Heads-up — Sundance POC kicked off. They want to validate a multilingual embedding + chat flow using a 13B open-model variant. Main constraints: EU data residency, FIPS-compliant KMS, deterministic tokenization for legal redaction, and p95 latency <= 120ms. Also asking for committed pricing for a 6mo Dedicated pool.
Sam (Sales): Thanks Maya. Do they want Dedicated from day 1 or try hosted then scale? Any size / concurrency targets yet?
Maya R: They prefer Dedicated for the SLA and data isolation, but will consider hosted if the cost delta is huge. Target is ~50 qps (short requests, 256 tokens typical) during peak, mostly read-only embeddings + short chat.
Raj P (eng-ml): Quick take — compatible in principle. Deterministic tokenization is the trickiest bit; most open 13B variants use standard tokenizers but redaction determinism often wants a fixed tokenizer mapping. We can support custom tokenizer artifacts on Private deployments or Dedicated with Private control plane.
Sam (Sales): If we need Private for tokenizers, that ups the procurement curve. Can we get a compatibility test running fast on Hosted to prove perf + cost numbers, then show Dedicated delta?
Raj P (eng-ml): Yes. Suggest running a 1-hour soak with a quantized variant to measure p95 and cost. Candidate model: "llama-13b-q4f16-v2" (quantized) or the full fp16 variant if they insist on perfect parity. For deterministic tokenization during the POC we can run a shim tokenizer client-side and send normalized inputs.
Maya R: They also flagged KMS — specifically FIPS 140-2. Is that available for Dedicated/private?
Elena S (security): FIPS KMS is supported for Private deployments integrated with customer-managed HSM/KMS. For Hosted we use cloud KMS (not FIPS by default). We can offer a compliance add-on and a short attestation package for SOC2 + export controls. Request: legal/security contact from Sundance so we can share the questionnaire answers.
Sam (Sales): Got it. I'll collect the security contact. Meanwhile can you give me a ballpark committed price for 8x A100-equivalent Dedicated pool vs running hosted during the POC? Need something I can put in the one-pager.
Raj P (eng-ml): Ballpark numbers (very rough):
- Dedicated reserve (8x A100-equivalent): ~$18k–$30k/month depending on commit term & network/storage addons.
- Hosted POC (burst + token pricing): estimate ~$1.5k–$4k for a 1-month low-volume soak (depends on token volume and KV cache hit rate).
Notes: quantized variant reduces GPU RAM and throughput needs; batching and prefix-KV caching can cut token cost ~30–60% depending on reuse.
Chris B (ops): From infra perspective, if they want EU residency + FIPS KMS + 50 qps, recommend provisioning across 2 racks for headroom (autoscale/burst enabled). We should also confirm egress/networking requirements and if any IP allowlists are needed.
Maya R: Sundance asked if we can pin model versions and do canary rollouts during the POC. They want deterministic behavior between runs.
Raj P (eng-ml): We support model pinning and gradual rollout (canary/A-B). For determinism: pin model artifact + tokenizer + seed. Also ensure KV cache warm-up is consistent in tests — cold vs warm cache will change p95.
Sam (Sales): Can you draft a short runbook for the POC I can share? Quick checklist, minimal commands to run compatibility tests, and what files we need from the customer.
Raj P (eng-ml): I'll put a quick checklist here.
```
- Ask Sundance for: sample model artifact (if custom), a representative input corpus (2k lines), tokenizer mapping if custom, and a security contact.
- Run hosted smoke: 10k requests over 1 hour using quantized model. Example call (replace API_KEY + model):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/outputs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-13b-q4f16-v2","input":"<sample text>","options":{"max_tokens":256}}'
- Capture p95 latency, token usage, KV cache hit% (if enabled).
- If deterministic tokenization required: run local tokenizer script on inputs and attach normalized payloads rather than relying on server-side tokenizer.
- For Dedicated sizing: run a 1-hour soak at target concurrency and measure GPU utilization and queueing.
```

Raj P (eng-ml): I'll run the hosted smoke for them if they provide the sample corpus and API access. ETA: can start tomorrow, results same business day if corpus small.
Elena S (security): Also add: logs retention and access controls — Sundance requires 90-day audit logs, restricted to their SOC team. We can offer as an add-on for Private/Dedicated. Will prepare template answers to their questionnaire once I have their security contact.
Sam (Sales): Thanks all. Action items: Sam to collect security contact and sample corpus; Raj to run hosted smoke once corpus received; Elena to prepare security answers and compliance add-on pricing; Chris to draft minimal infra diagram for 8x pool. I'll loop in AE and legal.
Maya R: Perfect. Sundance is eager to kick off this week. @Raj P (eng-ml) please ping me when you start the run so I can coordinate the customer. :thumbsup:
